# Demand Pump Probe Template

Use this before treating a customer/channel relationship as sustainable demand.

```text
organization:
organization_type:
demand_pump_mechanism:
why_new_tasks_keep_appearing:
who_owns_payment_authority:
recent_task_count_signal:
recent_overflow_task:
current_workaround:
current_cost:
can_desensitize:
external_collaboration_allowed:
bounded_output_possible:
objective_acceptance_possible:
likely CapabilityUnit:
would_pay_for_accepted_output:
repeat_frequency:
second-task path:
bypass risk:
orchestration recurring value:
G0:
G1:
G2:
G3:
G4:
G5:
G6:
evidence_level:
next_decisive_action:
```

A Demand Pump is not proven because an organization is large or has many customers. It is proven only when recurring task events reach the orchestration system and can transact under viable economics.
